Name: Glam Kitchen - Queen of Sauce TV Replacer
Author: AirynS
Description:
[list]
[*]Is your food lacking in spice?
[*]Feel like you need more gigantic hats in your life?
[*]Do you feel like the Queen of Sauce is too nice?
[/list]
Tune in instead to the Glam Kitchen, where the Glam Chef will teach you the secrets of glam cooking!

Inspired by TikTok artist [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@shiadanni]Shiadanni[/url]’s Glam Kitchen series, this mod replaces the Queen of Sauce TV channel with a new cooking show called The Glam Kitchen with custom art and dialogue. Live life… with GLAM.

(Note: for compatibility reasons, this mod does not affect dialogue by other characters, so they may still reference the Queen of Sauce. You can imagine that she still has her show but the channel isn’t available on the farmer’s TV.)

[b][size=4]Configuration[/size]

[/b]Glam Kitchen has two config options.

[b]WeeklyTimeslot[/b]: This option chooses whether Glam Kitchen will replace Queen of Sauce on both days, only replace Sunday episodes (with Queen of Sauce playing on Wednesday as a re-run), or only replace Wednesday re-runs (with Queen of Sauce playing on a Sunday).

[b]GlamKitty[/b]: This option changes the Glam Chef to a kitty! Designed for compatibility with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9387]Kitty Channels[/url], this option will automatically be enabled if Kitty Channels is installed.

This mod is i18n-compatible, so if anyone would like to translate it, please send me a copy of the translated default.json and I'll gladly add it with credit!
